Bhopal Hosts Harmonica Festival Inaugurated by CM Mohan Yadav

Bhopal resonated with the melodious sounds of the harmonica as Chief Minister Mohan Yadav inaugurated a harmonica festival. He described the event not just as a program but as a 'Kumbh' for music practitioners, with audiences immersed in the musical waves.
